title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights of Chelsea v Arsenal and Everton v Manchester United.
synopsis_medium: Highlights of the day's two Premier League games – Chelsea v Arsenal and Everton v Manchester United – and August's Goal of the Month.
synopsis_long: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's two Premier League games as well as August’s Goal of the Month. Champions Arsenal face Xabi Alonso’s new-look Chelsea in a London derby, whilst Manchester United travel to Everton having won on their only previous visit to the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
synopsis_editorial: With Arsenal v Chelsea and Everton v Man Utd, plus Goal of the Month
